# Vendored ganja.js

Ganja.js by Steven De Keninck, MIT license (included in `ganja.LICENSE`).

Pinned upstream: https://github.com/enkimute/ganja.js/tree/6e97cb45d780cd7c661d9240f1610eb005707417

The unmodified upstream library and license are hashed in `manifest.json`.
`pga.js` uses its Float64 Cl(2,0,1) algebra, and `ganja-view.js` uses its native SVG graph renderer. Our Pointer Events adapter supplies consistent rectangular-viewport dragging, touch, and keyboard controls. This library is a numerical illustration dependency, not part of Lean's trusted proof base.

The Pascal straightedge construction adapts Yao Liu's own notebook:
https://observablehq.com/@liuyao12/conics-sections (inspected notebook revision 1069).

No Observable account or external CDN is required to run the published page.
